description: Test of the privilege stage of the ops core (S5a, feature A18): an administrator account sees the owner's profile on an owned PC and installs a USB device the PC's policy would refuse, only while its session is live and only at the keyboard for a device that needs someone signed in; a step up from a typed session reaches admin. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove an ordinary account sees only its own profile, an administrator also sees the owner's, the taskbar marks an administrator session, a keystroke device at the bay socket is refused for a remote session with its own line and accepted at the keyboard under admin, a locked session overrides nothing, a relay session never steps up and a typed session does
